locatorProfile.dominantStrategy: role+label (i18n-sensitive, no data-testid found in source or DOM). First/Last name inputs additionally have stable id attributes (wl-firstname, wl-lastname, wl-company, wl-role, wl-usecase) usable as a fallback CSS locator.

notes: No login wall encountered; anonymous access works as expected (mode='anonymous', no ?email= param).
No unexpected redirect; URL stayed at /join-waitlist for the whole crawl.
No console errors or warnings observed during the crawl.

KEY FINDING: 'Send Verify Code' is gated only on the email field being non-empty after trim() — it does NOT check for a valid-looking email format. Typing 'notanemail' (no @ or domain) enables the button. Real format validation (zod z.email()) only runs at click-time inside handleSendOtp, surfacing an inline error. Test cases asserting 'button stays disabled for invalid-format email' would be WRONG for this component — only truly empty/whitespace-only input keeps it disabled.

KEY FINDING: 'Submit Application' is enabled from initial page load regardless of whether any required field (firstName/lastName/company/role/useCase) is filled, or whether the email has been OTP-verified. It is only disabled while isSubmitting (mid-request). All required-field and email-verification checks happen inside the onClick handler (validateForm() via zod, then emailState check) and surface as a toast ('Please verify your email before submitting') or inline FieldErrors — not as a disabled button. Verified by clicking Submit Application on an all-empty, unverified form: it safely short-circuited to the email-not-verified toast, with no field-level errors shown yet and no network call made.

Cancel button confirmed: calls resetAllState() (clears all fields/otp/countdown state) then router.back(), navigating away from /join-waitlist to whatever the browser history's previous entry was (in this crawl: back to /quick-activate, the page open before this crawl started). On a real user's first visit (e.g. arriving via direct link/ad with no prior history), router.back() could be a no-op or leave the SPA — worth a low-priority note for edge-case testing but not exercised further in this smoke scope.

TOOLING CAVEAT (not a page bug): the chrome-devtools MCP `fill` tool, when used to set a controlled React input to an empty string or whitespace-only string right after a prior non-empty fill, did not reliably re-trigger React's onChange/disabled recomputation (DOM value read back as '' but Send Verify Code stayed enabled). Re-tested with real keystroke simulation (type_text + Control+A + Backspace) and the disabled state correctly recomputed to true on true-empty input. Recommend using type_text/press_key (not fill) when testing empty/whitespace edge cases on controlled inputs in this codebase.

i18n data note: the local QA messages snapshot at tests/e2e/local/messages/en.json is missing 'firstName'/'lastName'/'firstNamePlaceholder'/'lastNamePlaceholder' keys (and likely other auth.joinWaitlist keys) that DO exist in the actual app source at apps/mira-work/i18n/messages/en/auth.json — the live page renders these labels correctly ('First name', 'Last name'), confirming the deployed app is fine; the local QA messages copy is just stale/incomplete relative to the real per-namespace i18n files and should not be used as the sole source of truth for i18nKey verification on this page.

Deep OTP-verified submit flow (otp-sent state, OTP verification, and the actual authenticated Submit Application success path to /join-waitlist/success) was intentionally NOT exercised — doing so requires sending/receiving a real OTP email, out of scope for this lightweight smoke crawl.
